name: blastradius-mcp
description: Zero-trust security proxy for MCP: pre-execution blast radius simulation, DLP redaction, step-up approval tokens, and a hash-chained audit ledger.
long_description: BlastRadius MCP is a local stdio Model Context Protocol server that sits between an AI agent and the tools it wants to call. Before anything executes, `simulate_action` scores the action (danger 0-100), estimates blast radius, and reports how reversible it would be. `inspect_payload_dlp` scans text, code, and logs for API keys, passwords, JWTs, cloud credentials, credit cards, SSNs, and PII, and returns a masked copy. `enforce_policy` is the central decision point: it evaluates a prospective tool call against a policy profile, DLP-scans the parameters, and appends a hash-chained audit entry. High-impact actions require an HMAC-SHA256 signed, time-bound step-up token minted by `request_confirmation_token`, which makes human approval non-repudiable. `verify_audit_log` re-walks the hash chain to detect tampering, deletions, or unauthorized edits, and `get_security_posture` reports live threat statistics, the active policy profile, and DLP redaction totals. The server is fully local: it opens no sockets, sends nothing to third parties, and has no license key or paid tier.

tools.name: route_tool
tools.description: Semantic and keyword intent router. Resolves natural-language intent to optimal downstream MCP tools with JIT schema retrieval and >85% token reduction.

intent.description: Intent or target tool to invoke.

executeImmediately.description: Whether to execute if policy allows.

toolArguments.description: Arguments to pass to target tool.

tools.name: virtualize_context
tools.description: Compresses large tool outputs, diffs, and logs into lightweight virtual handles, saving up to 90% agent context tokens.

rawContent.description: Raw text, logs, or payload to virtualize.

tools.name: simulate_swarm_impact
tools.description: Fast in-memory pre-flight safety simulator. Spawns 25-50 adversarial virtual personas (Hacker, Confused User, Concurrency Racer, Data Corruptor) to stress-test diffs and commands in under 3 seconds.

targetDiffOrCommand.description: Code diff, command, or action to simulate.

tools.name: adversarial_persona_review
tools.description: Deep targeted adversarial review executing specialized persona stress-testing (Hacker, Confused User, Legacy System, Concurrency Racer, Data Corruptor) with step-by-step reproduction steps.

targetDiffOrCommand.description: Code diff or action to review.

tools.name: blast_radius_heatmap
tools.description: Visual Blast Radius Heatmap generator. Renders Markdown, ASCII, or JSON matrices evaluating impacted components, user classes, data sensitivity, and containment feasibility.

targetDiffOrCommand.description: Code diff or command to generate blast radius heatmap for.

tools.name: enforce_tdd_state
tools.description: Strict Test-Driven Development (TDD) quality gate state machine. Enforces Red -> Green -> Refactor cycle before permitting production code modifications.

targetFilePath.description: Path to target production code file when checking write permissions.

tools.name: generate_socratic_spec
tools.description: Socratic requirement specification generator. Decomposes informal engineering requirements into rigorous, testable contracts with invariants, edge cases, and RED test plans.

tools.name: spawn_worktree_subagent
tools.description: Isolates subagents in parallel Git worktrees (.blastradius/worktrees/<agentId>) to prevent workspace contamination and race conditions.

baseBranch.description: Base branch to branch off of.

tools.name: automated_code_critique
tools.description: Senior-developer static and AST code critique. Detects silent error swallowing, dangerous sinks, missing test assertions, unchecked inputs, and unbounded queries.

diffOrCode.description: Code diff or content to critique.

tools.name: verify_audit_log
tools.description: Cryptographically verifies the immutable hash-chained audit ledger to detect tampering, deleted records, or unauthorized log modifications.

limit.description: Number of recent audit records to verify.

tools.name: request_confirmation_token
tools.description: Generates a time-bound, cryptographically signed (HMAC-SHA256) step-up approval token allowing an agent to execute high-impact actions when human consent is granted.

toolName.description: The specific tool name to authorize.

actionFingerprint.description: Unique signature or hash of the approved payload.

requestedBy.description: Identifier of the human supervisor or authorizing entity.

tools.name: get_security_posture
tools.description: Returns real-time security posture score (0-100), active policy status, compliance metrics, TDD state summary, and data flywheel learning telemetry.

signing_key.title: Approval Token Signing Key
signing_key.description: Optional HMAC-SHA256 secret used to sign step-up approval tokens. Leave blank to generate an ephemeral per-process key; approval tokens then stop validating when the server restarts.

audit_key.title: Audit Ledger Hash Key
audit_key.description: Optional HMAC-SHA256 secret used to chain audit ledger entries. Leave blank to generate an ephemeral per-process key; previously written audit entries then fail verification.

policy_file.title: Custom Security Policy File
policy_file.description: Optional path to a JSON security policy config, equivalent to the --policy CLI flag. Leave blank to use the built-in policy profiles.
